grammarPages.learnerPromise: React with surprise or disbelief about a quality or situation.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern shows a feeling of surprise or disbelief about a certain situation. When using this pattern, the speaker does not always ask for a reply.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern shows a feeling of surprise or disbelief about a certain situation. When using this pattern, the speaker does not always ask for a reply.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern shows a feeling of surprise or disbelief about a certain situation. When using this pattern, the speaker does not always ask for a reply.
grammarPages.pattern: 怎麼這麼 + Vs（+ ...）

text.traditional: A：這個卡通人物怎麼這麼可愛！B：真的嗎？我覺得史努比比較可愛。
text.english: A: How can this cartoon character be so cute! B: Really? I think Snoopy is cuter.
text.simplified: A：这个卡通人物怎么这么可爱！B：真的吗？我觉得史努比比较可爱。
text.pinyin: A: Zhège kǎtōng rénwù zěnme zhème kě'ài! B: Zhēnde ma? Wǒ juéde Shǐnǔbǐ bǐjiào kě'ài.

text.traditional: 你怎麼這麼累？昨天晚上沒睡覺嗎？
text.english: How can you be so tired? Didn’t you sleep last night?
text.simplified: 你怎么这么累？昨天晚上没睡觉吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhème lèi? Zuótiān wǎnshàng méi shuìjiào ma?

text.traditional: 明天有期末考，你怎麼這麼輕鬆？都準備好了嗎？
text.english: You have a final exam tomorrow. How can you be so relaxed? Are you all prepared?
text.simplified: 明天有期末考，你怎么这么轻松？都准备好了吗？
text.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu qímòkǎo, nǐ zěnme zhème qīngsōng? Dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?

summary: 怎麼這麼 plus a state word shows surprise or disbelief about a situation.
The speaker is not always waiting for an answer.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Enough Room or Capacity with 得下／不下
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether a place or person has enough capacity to hold, contain, or eat something.
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “下” is a resultative complement indicating whether or not the subject has enough space to accommodate the object. Sometimes, the situation results from the subject's mental or physical factors. This resultative complement only has potential structure.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, “下” is a resultative complement indicating whether or not the subject has enough space to accommodate the object. Sometimes, the situation results from the subject's mental or physical factors. This resultative complement only has potential structure.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “下” is a resultative complement indicating whether or not the subject has enough space to accommodate the object. Sometimes, the situation results from the subject's mental or physical factors. This resultative complement only has potential structure.
grammarPages.pattern: V 得下／V 不下 + Object

text.traditional: 這個盒子裝得下幾塊蛋糕？
text.english: How many pieces of cake can fit in this box?
text.simplified: 这个盒子装得下几块蛋糕？
text.pinyin: Zhège hézi zhuāng de xià jǐ kuài dàngāo?

text.traditional: 這間公寓很大，住得下六個人。
text.english: This apartment is large enough for six people to live in.
text.simplified: 这间公寓很大，住得下六个人。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiān gōngyù hěn dà, zhù de xià liù ge rén.

text.traditional: 我剛剛吃了好幾個包子，現在吃不下了。
text.english: I just ate several steamed buns; I can’t eat any more now.
text.simplified: 我刚刚吃了好几个包子，现在吃不下了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng chī le hǎojǐ ge bāozi, xiànzài chī bú xià le.

summary: V得下 and V不下 say whether there is enough room, or enough ability, to fit or finish something.
In this meaning, 下 is used only in these two forms.

text.traditional: （看看牆上的鐘）可欣，已經十二點多了，妳明天早上不是有課嗎？快點兒去睡吧！
text.simplified: （看看墙上的钟）可欣，已经十二点多了，你明天早上不是有课吗？快点儿去睡吧！
text.pinyin: (Kànkan qiángshàng de zhōng) Kěxīn, yǐjīng shí'èr diǎn duō le, nǐ míngtiān zǎoshàng búshì yǒu kè ma? Kuài diǎnr qù shuì ba!
text.english: (Looking at the clock on the wall) Kexin, it's already past 12 o'clock. Don't you have classes tomorrow morning? Hurry up and go to sleep!

text.traditional: 我還不能睡。後天日本歷史考試要從第五課考到第八課，（她翻了翻書）我還有十幾頁沒念完。
text.simplified: 我还不能睡。后天日本历史考试要从第五课考到第八课，（她翻了翻书）我还有十几页没念完。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hái bùnéng shuì. Hòutiān Rìběn lìshǐ kǎoshì yào cóng dìwǔ kè kǎo dào dì bā kè, (tā fān le fān shū) wǒ háiyǒu shíjǐ yè méi niàn wán.
text.english: I can't go to sleep yet. The Japanese history exam the day after tomorrow will cover lessons 5 to 8. (She flipped through the book.) I still have more than 10 pages to finish.

text.traditional: 可是妳最近都只吃三明治，又很晚才睡，這樣對身體不好吧？
text.simplified: 可是你最近都只吃三明治，又很晚才睡，这样对身体不好吧？
text.pinyin: Kěshì nǐ zuìjìn dōu zhǐ chī sānmíngzhì, yòu hěn wǎn cái shuì, zhèyàng duì shēntǐ bùhǎo ba?
text.english: But you've been recently eating only sandwiches, and you go to sleep very late. It isn't good for your body, is it?

text.traditional: 沒辦法。這門課除了有課堂小考，期末還要考口試和寫一篇作文。要是不用功一點兒，就會被當的！
text.simplified: 没办法。这门课除了有课堂小考，期末还要考口试和写一篇作文。要是不用功一点儿，就会被当的！
text.pinyin: Méibànfǎ. Zhè mén kè chúle yǒu kètáng xiǎo kǎo, qímò háiyào kǎo kǒushì hé xiě yì piān zuòwén. Yàoshì búyòng gōng yìdiǎnr, jiù huì bèi dāng de!
text.english: There's no other way. In this course there are classroom quizzes. Moreover, at the end of the semester, we have to take an oral exam and write a composition. If we don't study harder, we may flunk the course!

text.traditional: 聽起來很辛苦，妳為什麼要修這門課呢？
text.simplified: 听起来很辛苦，你为什么要修这门课呢？
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn xīnkǔ, nǐ wèishénme yào xiū zhè mén kè ne?
text.english: Sounds tough. Why did you want to take this course?

text.traditional: 因為那位教授知識很豐富，教法也很好。
text.simplified: 因为那位教授知识很丰富，教法也很好。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi nà wèi jiàoshòu zhīshì hěn fēngfù, jiàofǎ yě hěn hǎo.
text.english: Because the professor's knowledge is very vast, and the methods of teaching are very good, too.

text.traditional: 我們義大利文系的課好像比較輕鬆。這學期我沒修多少課，只有一門文法課要考筆試，其他兩門課只要交報告就好了。
text.simplified: 我们义大利文系的课好像比较轻松。这学期我没修多少课，只有一门文法课要考笔试，其他两门课只要交报告就好了。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen Yìdàlì wén xì de kè hǎoxiàng bǐjiào qīngsōng. Zhè xuéqí wǒ méi xiū duōshǎo kè, zhǐyǒu yì mén wénfǎ kè yào kǎo bǐshì, qítā liǎng mén kè zhǐyào jiāo bàogào jiù hǎo le.
text.english: Courses of the Department of Italian Language seem more laid-back. This semester I don't take too many courses. There is only one grammar course in which I have to take a written exam. In the other two, I only need to hand in reports.

text.traditional: 如果沒有期末考，教授怎麼給你們成績呢？
text.simplified: 如果没有期末考，教授怎么给你们成绩呢？
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu qímòkǎo, jiàoshòu zěnme gěi nǐmen chéngjī ne?
text.english: How does the professor score you if there is no final exam?

text.traditional: 只要平常認真上課，多查字典，把他要我們翻譯的文章翻好，期末成績就不會太差。
text.simplified: 只要平常认真上课，多查字典，把他要我们翻译的文章翻好，期末成绩就不会太差。
text.pinyin: Zhǐyào píngcháng rènzhēn shàngkè, duō chá zìdiǎn, bǎ tā yào wǒmen fānyì de wénzhāng fān hǎo, qímò chéngjī jiù bú huì tài chà.
text.english: As long as we concentrate in class, use the dictionary often, and translate the articles he assigns, our final scores won't be too bad.

text.traditional: 怎麼這麼好！上次考試我太緊張，有幾題沒寫完，考得比較差，這次我一定要更努力！
text.simplified: 怎么这么好！上次考试我太紧张，有几题没写完，考得比较差，这次我一定要更努力！
text.pinyin: Zěnme zhème hǎo! Shàng cì kǎoshì wǒ tài jǐnzhāng, yǒu jǐ tí méi xiě wán, kǎo de bǐjiào chà, zhè cì wǒ yídìng yào gèng nǔlì!
text.english: How can it be that good! I was too stressed on my last exam. I didn't finish several questions, so I got a worse grade. This time I must work harder!

text.traditional: 我小時候也很怕考試，有時候一緊張就吃不下飯，現在好多了。
text.simplified: 我小时候也很怕考试，有时候一紧张就吃不下饭，现在好多了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu yě hěn pà kǎoshì, yǒushíhòu yì jǐnzhāng jiù chī bú xià fàn, xiànzài hǎo duō le.
text.english: When I was little, I was afraid of taking exams, too. Sometimes I was so stressed that I couldn't eat, but it's much better now.

text.traditional: 我覺得平常就應該多讀書，讓自己的能力更好，將來才比較容易找到好工作。
text.simplified: 我觉得平常就应该多读书，让自己的能力更好，将来才比较容易找到好工作。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde píngcháng jiù yīnggāi duō dúshū, ràng zìjǐ de nénglì gèng hǎo, jiānglái cái bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò.
text.english: I think we should normally study more to improve our own ability. In the future it will be easier to find a good job.

text.traditional: 念書當然很重要，可是妳今天念的書已經夠多了，現在最重要是睡覺喔！
text.simplified: 念书当然很重要，可是你今天念的书已经够多了，现在最重要是睡觉喔！
text.pinyin: Niànshū dāngrán hěn zhòngyào, kěshì nǐ jīntiān niàn de shū yǐjīng gòu duō le, xiànzài zuì zhòngyào shì shuìjiào o!
text.english: Although studying is certainly important, you have already studied enough for today. For now, the most important thing is sleep!

text.traditional: 好好好，我把這一頁念完就去洗澡、睡覺，明天再加油吧！
text.simplified: 好好好，我把这一页念完就去洗澡、睡觉，明天再加油吧！
text.pinyin: Hǎo hǎohǎo, wǒ bǎ zhè yí yè niàn wán jiù qù xǐzǎo, shuìjiào, míngtiān zài jiāyóu ba!
text.english: Alright, alright, alright! When I finish reading this page, I'll take a bath and go to bed right away. Tomorrow I'll keep going!

items.title: Grammar 7 · Ryosuke Yamamoto’s Life of Studying Abroad

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a quality with a vivid, high-degree form, and place it correctly before a noun, in a complement, or before a verb.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern of reduplication of state verb is “Vs Vs 的/地”. Reduplication of Vs can be divided into monosyllabic Vs reduplication and disyllabic Vs reduplication. The structure of monosyllabic Vs reduplication is simple; for example, “香香的” and “慢慢地”. On the other hand, the structure of disyllabic Vs (XY) reduplication is “XXYY 的/地”; for example, “漂漂亮亮的” and “舒舒服服地”. This pattern cannot be used together with degree adverb (“非常” and “很”) because reduplication of Vs already implies a high degree. When reduplication of Vs serves as a predicate, “的” is necessary to be added, e.g., “他的眼睛大大的” and “他的房間乾乾淨淨的”. When reduplication of Vs serves as a complement, “的” can be omitted, e.g., “他們玩得開開心心（的）”. However, not every state verb can be used in this pattern. For example, “貴 (expensive)”, “忙 (busy)”, “新 (new)”, “好吃 (good to eat)”, “好喝 (good to drink)”, “可愛 (cute)”, “可怕 (terrible)”, “不錯 (not bad)” are inappropriate in this pattern.

text.traditional: 這朵玫瑰花紅紅的，真漂亮！
text.english: This rose is red and beautiful!
text.simplified: 这朵玫瑰花红红的，真漂亮！
text.pinyin: Zhè duǒ méiguihuā hóng hóng de, zhēn piàoliàng!

text.traditional: 這塊蛋糕香香甜甜的，真好吃！
text.english: This cake is fragrant and sweet; it tastes great!
text.simplified: 这块蛋糕香香甜甜的，真好吃！
text.pinyin: Zhè kuài dàngāo xiāng xiāng tián tián de, zhēn hǎochī!

text.traditional: 這家民宿乾乾淨淨的，住起來很舒服。
text.english: This guesthouse is clean and comfortable to stay in.
text.simplified: 这家民宿干干净净的，住起来很舒服。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù gān gānjìng jìng de, zhù qǐlái hěn shūfu.

text.traditional: 他有一張圓圓的臉，很可愛！
text.english: He has a round face and is very cute!
text.simplified: 他有一张圆圆的脸，很可爱！
text.pinyin: Tā yǒu yì zhāng yuán yuán de liǎn, hěn kě'ài!

text.traditional: 去花蓮可以看到藍藍的大海，風景美極了。
text.english: In Hualien, you can see the blue sea; the scenery is beautiful.
text.simplified: 去花莲可以看到蓝蓝的大海，风景美极了。
text.pinyin: Qù Huālián kěyǐ kàndào lán lán de dàhǎi, fēngjǐng měi jíle.

text.traditional: 明天晚上我要去台北101，參加熱熱鬧鬧的跨年晚會。
text.english: Tomorrow night I am going to Taipei 101 to attend a lively New Year’s Eve party.
text.simplified: 明天晚上我要去台北101，参加热热闹闹的跨年晚会。
text.pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshàng wǒ yào qù Táiběi 101, cānjiā rè rènao nào de kuànián wǎnhuì.

text.traditional: 他每天早上都吃得飽飽的再去上班。
text.english: He eats until he is full every morning before going to work.
text.simplified: 他每天早上都吃得饱饱的再去上班。
text.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshàng dōu chī de bǎo bǎo de zài qù shàngbān.

text.traditional: 老師說，漢字一定要寫得清清楚楚的。
text.english: The teacher says Chinese characters must be written clearly.
text.simplified: 老师说，汉字一定要写得清清楚楚的。
text.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, Hànzì yídìng yào xiě de qīng qīngchǔ chǔ de.

text.traditional: 因為有客人要來，所以他把房間打掃得乾乾淨淨的。
text.english: Because guests are coming, he cleaned the room thoroughly.
text.simplified: 因为有客人要来，所以他把房间打扫得干干净净的。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu kèrén yào lái, suǒyǐ tā bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de gān gānjìng jìng de.

text.traditional: 這座森林的風景很美，我們慢慢地看吧。
text.english: The scenery in this forest is beautiful. Let’s take our time looking at it.
text.simplified: 这座森林的风景很美，我们慢慢地看吧。
text.pinyin: Zhè zuò sēnlín de fēngjǐng hěn měi, wǒmen màn màn de kàn ba.

text.traditional: 店員客客氣氣地跟顧客介紹新商品，希望他們多買一些。
text.english: The clerk politely introduces the new products to customers, hoping they will buy more.
text.simplified: 店员客客气气地跟顾客介绍新商品，希望他们多买一些。
text.pinyin: Diànyuán kè kèqì qì de gēn gùkè jièshào xīn shāngpǐn, xīwàng tāmen duō mǎi yìxiē.

text.traditional: 他很喜歡學中文，每天都開開心心地去上課。
text.english: He likes studying Chinese and goes to class happily every day.
text.simplified: 他很喜欢学中文，每天都开开心心地去上课。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān xué Zhōngwén, měitiān dōu kāi kāixīn xīn de qù shàngkè.

subsections.title: Before a noun
subsections.explanation: Reduplicated state verbs modify the following noun with 的.

subsections.title: Complement
subsections.titleTraditional: S + V 得 + Vs Vs／XXYY + 的
subsections.explanation: As a complement, 的 may be omitted; the printed examples include it.
subsections.pattern: S + V 得 + Vs Vs／XXYY + 的

subsections.title: Before a verb
subsections.explanation: 地 marks the reduplicated state verb as an adverbial modifier.

summary: Some state words can be doubled to show a high degree: AA for one syllable, AABB for two.
Use 的 when the doubled word describes the subject or a noun after it. Use 地 when it describes a verb.
Doubling already means a high degree, so don't add 很 or 非常.
Not every state word can be doubled.

text.traditional: 山本良介的大學跟台灣的大學有交換學生的計畫，他很喜歡台灣，所以決定來台灣留學。到了台灣以後，他不但認真地上日文系的課，也在華語文中心學習中文。以前他在日本就學過漢語，他覺得寫漢字一點兒也不難，但是文法跟聲調這兩個部分還需要多練習。
text.simplified: 山本良介的大学跟台湾的大学有交换学生的计划，他很喜欢台湾，所以决定来台湾留学。到了台湾以后，他不但认真地上日文系的课，也在华语文中心学习中文。以前他在日本就学过汉语，他觉得写汉字一点儿也不难，但是文法跟声调这两个部分还需要多练习。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè de dàxué gēn Táiwān de dàxué yǒu jiāohuàn xuéshēng de jìhuà, tā hěn xǐhuān Táiwān, suǒyǐ juédìng lái Táiwān liúxué. Dào le Táiwān yǐhòu, tā búdàn rènzhēn de shàng Rìwén xì de kè, yě zài Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn xuéxí Zhōngwén. Yǐqián tā zài Rìběn jiù xué guo Hànyǔ, tā juéde xiě Hànzì yìdiǎnr yě bù nán, dànshì wénfǎ gēn shēngdiào zhè liǎng ge bùfèn hái xūyào duō liànxí.
text.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto’s university has an exchange program with a Taiwanese university. He likes Taiwan very much, so he decided to study in Taiwan. After coming to Taiwan, he not only earnestly studies the courses at the Department of Japanese Language, but also learns Chinese at the Center of Chinese Language and Culture. He has already been learning Chinese in Japan. He thinks writing Chinese characters isn’t difficult at all, but in the two aspects of grammar and tones, he still needs more practice.

text.traditional: 良介的中文老師很好，總是把生字、課文意思說得清清楚楚。不但要他們用文法造句，還要用中文報告，讓他們練習表達自己意見。期末考有筆試和作文，如果文章錯字太多或是文法不對，成績就比較差。
text.simplified: 良介的中文老师很好，总是把生字、课文意思说得清清楚楚。不但要他们用文法造句，还要用中文报告，让他们练习表达自己意见。期末考有笔试和作文，如果文章错字太多或是文法不对，成绩就比较差。
text.pinyin: Liángjiè de Zhōngwén lǎoshī hěn hǎo, zǒngshì bǎ shēngzì, kèwén yìsi shuō de qīng qīngchǔ chǔ. Búdàn yào tāmen yòng wénfǎ zàojù, háiyào yòng Zhōngwén bàogào, ràng tāmen liànxí biǎodá zìjǐ yìjiàn. Qímòkǎo yǒu bǐshì hé zuòwén, rúguǒ wénzhāng cuòzì tài duō huòshì wénfǎ búduì, chéngjī jiù bǐjiào chà.
text.english: Ryosuke’s Chinese teacher is very good. He always explains new vocabulary and the meaning of texts clearly. He asks them not only to build sentences with grammar, but also to make presentations in Chinese, letting them practice expressing their own opinions. On the final exam, they have to write a composition and take a written test. However, if too many characters are written incorrectly in the essay or if the grammar is incorrect, the score will be lower.

text.traditional: 良介在台灣交了不少朋友，他常跟他們練習說中文、問他們語法的問題。剛開學的時候，同學帶他去圖書館，教他怎麼借書、還書。有一次他搭錯車、迷了路，台灣人看到他很著急的樣子，就馬上來幫忙，告訴他怎麼走，讓良介非常感動。
text.simplified: 良介在台湾交了不少朋友，他常跟他们练习说中文、问他们语法的问题。刚开学的时候，同学带他去图书馆，教他怎么借书、还书。有一次他搭错车、迷了路，台湾人看到他很着急的样子，就马上来帮忙，告诉他怎么走，让良介非常感动。
text.pinyin: Liángjiè zài Táiwān jiāo le bùshǎo péngyǒu, tā cháng gēn tāmen liànxí shuō Zhōngwén, wèn tāmen yǔfǎ de wèntí. Gāng kāixué de shíhòu, tóngxué dài tā qù túshūguǎn, jiāo tā zěnme jiè shū, huán shū. Yǒu yí cì tā dā cuò chē, mí le lù, Táiwān rén kàndào tā hěn zhāojí de yàngzi, jiù mǎshàng lái bāngmáng, gàosu tā zěnme zǒu, ràng Liángjiè fēicháng gǎndòng.
text.english: Ryosuke makes a lot of friends in Taiwan. He often practices speaking Chinese with them and asks them questions about grammar. When the semester just began, the classmates took him to the library and taught him how to borrow or return books. Once he took the wrong bus and got lost, Taiwanese people saw he was so anxious that they immediately came to help and told him how to get there. It made him feel very touched.

text.traditional: 最近，同學們都在討論找工作的問題。良介也很煩惱，所以他決定先請教授給他一些建議，再想想將來要怎麼做。
text.simplified: 最近，同学们都在讨论找工作的问题。良介也很烦恼，所以他决定先请教授给他一些建议，再想想将来要怎么做。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn, tóngxué men dōu zài tǎolùn zhǎo gōngzuò de wèntí. Liángjiè yě hěn fánnǎo, suǒyǐ tā juédìng xiān qǐng jiàoshòu gěi tā yìxiē jiànyì, zài xiǎng xiǎng jiānglái yào zěnme zuò.
text.english: Recently, all of the classmates have been talking about the problem of finding a job. Ryosuke is also troubled with this, so he decides to ask a professor for some advice and then think of what to do in the future.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Let’s Go Work Out after Class!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Not Only…, But Also… with 不但…而且…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Link two clauses to add a second, stronger point.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern connects two short sentences. The latter sentence shows a higher degree than the former. (1) If the two sentences have the same Subject, the Subject is placed before “不但”, and the Subject in the second sentence can be omitted. (2) If the two sentences have different Subjects, the Subjects should be placed after “不但” and “而且” respectively, e.g., “我做的菜，不但爸爸喜歡，而且媽媽也喜歡。”
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern connects two short sentences. The latter sentence shows a higher degree than the former. (1) If the two sentences have the same Subject, the Subject is placed before “不但”, and the Subject in the second sentence can be omitted. (2) If the two sentences have different Subjects, the Subjects should be placed after “不但” and “而且” respectively, e.g., “我做的菜，不但爸爸喜歡，而且媽媽也喜歡。”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern connects two short sentences. The latter sentence shows a higher degree than the former. (1) If the two sentences have the same Subject, the Subject is placed before “不但”, and the Subject in the second sentence can be omitted. (2) If the two sentences have different Subjects, the Subjects should be placed after “不但” and “而且” respectively, e.g., “我做的菜，不但爸爸喜歡，而且媽媽也喜歡。”
grammarPages.pattern: S + 不但 + clause，(而且) + clause

text.traditional: A：你會說中文嗎？B：我不但會說中文，而且會說台灣話。
text.simplified: A：你会说中文吗？B：我不但会说中文，而且会说台湾话。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ huì shuō Zhōngwén ma? B: Wǒ búdàn huì shuō Zhōngwén, érqiě huì shuō Táiwān huà.
text.english: A: Can you speak Chinese? B: I can speak not only Chinese but also Taiwanese.

text.traditional: A：你為什麼來台灣旅行？B：因為台灣不但風景美，而且交通也很方便。
text.simplified: A：你为什么来台湾旅行？B：因为台湾不但风景美，而且交通也很方便。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ wèishénme lái Táiwān lǚxíng? B: Yīnwèi Táiwān búdàn fēngjǐng měi, érqiě jiāotōng yě hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: A: Why did you come to Taiwan? B: Because Taiwan has not only beautiful scenery, but also very convenient transportation.

text.traditional: 媽媽：你打掃房間了嗎？孩子：我不但把房間打掃好了，而且髒衣服也洗乾淨了。
text.simplified: 妈妈：你打扫房间了吗？孩子：我不但把房间打扫好了，而且脏衣服也洗干净了。
text.pinyin: Māma: Nǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān le ma? Háizi: Wǒ búdàn bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo hǎo le, érqiě zāng yīfu yě xǐ gānjìng le.
text.english: Mom: Did you clean your room? Child: I not only cleaned the room up, but also washed the dirty clothes.

summary: 不但 and 而且 join two short sentences, and the second one says something even stronger.
If both sentences have the same subject, put it before 不但, and you can leave it out of the second sentence.
If the subjects are different, put one after 不但 and the other after 而且.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize an extreme state, usually a negative one.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern shows exaggeration with a higher degree than “Vs 得不得了” and “Vs 極了”. In most cases, it implies negative meanings. However, there are a small number of state verbs that can be used to show positive emotions, e.g., “高興死了”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern shows exaggeration with a higher degree than “Vs 得不得了” and “Vs 極了”. In most cases, it implies negative meanings. However, there are a small number of state verbs that can be used to show positive emotions, e.g., “高興死了”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern shows exaggeration with a higher degree than “Vs 得不得了” and “Vs 極了”. In most cases, it implies negative meanings. However, there are a small number of state verbs that can be used to show positive emotions, e.g., “高興死了”.
grammarPages.pattern: Vs + 死了

text.traditional: 百貨公司的大衣貴死了，我買不起。
text.simplified: 百货公司的大衣贵死了，我买不起。
text.pinyin: Bǎihuò gōngsī de dàyī guì sǐ le, wǒ mǎi bù qǐ.
text.english: The coats at the department store are incredibly expensive; I can’t afford one.

text.traditional: 昨天晚上隔壁鄰居一直在跳舞，吵死了。
text.simplified: 昨天晚上隔壁邻居一直在跳舞，吵死了。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng gébì línjū yìzhí zài tiàowǔ, chǎo sǐ le.
text.english: The neighbors next door danced all last night. It was terribly noisy.

text.traditional: 教授要我用中文報告在台灣的生活，讓我緊張死了。
text.simplified: 教授要我用中文报告在台湾的生活，让我紧张死了。
text.pinyin: Jiàoshòu yào wǒ yòng Zhōngwén bàogào zài Táiwān de shēnghuó, ràng wǒ jǐnzhāng sǐ le.
text.english: The professor asked me to give a report in Chinese about my life in Taiwan, which made me incredibly nervous.

summary: 死了 after a state word exaggerates it, and is stronger than 得不得了 and 極了.
It usually has a negative meaning.
A few state words can show happy feelings, such as 高興死了.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The More…, the More… with 越…越…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Show how a change in one degree or action affects another.
grammarPages.explanation: When the subject does the first action, the situation changes accordingly with the increase or decrease in the degree or number. The structure is “S 越 V₁/Vs₁ 越 V₂/Vs₂”. Besides, this pattern can have a second subject. When the first subject does something more frequently, the state of the second subject will change accordingly. The pattern is “S₁ 越 V₁/Vs₁，S₂ 越 V₂/Vs₂”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When the subject does the first action, the situation changes accordingly with the increase or decrease in the degree or number. The structure is “S 越 V₁/Vs₁ 越 V₂/Vs₂”. Besides, this pattern can have a second subject. When the first subject does something more frequently, the state of the second subject will change accordingly. The pattern is “S₁ 越 V₁/Vs₁，S₂ 越 V₂/Vs₂”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: When the subject does the first action, the situation changes accordingly with the increase or decrease in the degree or number. The structure is “S 越 V₁/Vs₁ 越 V₂/Vs₂”. Besides, this pattern can have a second subject. When the first subject does something more frequently, the state of the second subject will change accordingly. The pattern is “S₁ 越 V₁/Vs₁，S₂ 越 V₂/Vs₂”.
grammarPages.pattern: S + 越 + V₁/Vs₁，(S₂) + 越 + V₂/Vs₂

text.traditional: 山本良介的中文越說越好了。
text.simplified: 山本良介的中文越说越好了。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè de Zhōngwén yuè shuō yuè hǎo le.
text.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke’s Chinese is getting better and better.

text.traditional: 中文的語法不容易，老師越說，我越不懂。
text.simplified: 中文的语法不容易，老师越说，我越不懂。
text.pinyin: Zhōngwén de yǔfǎ bù róngyì, lǎoshī yuè shuō, wǒ yuè bù dǒng.
text.english: Chinese grammar isn’t easy. The more the teacher explains, the less I understand.

text.traditional: 房子離捷運站越近，房租越貴。
text.simplified: 房子离捷运站越近，房租越贵。
text.pinyin: Fángzi lí jiéyùn zhàn yuè jìn, fángzū yuè guì.
text.english: The closer a house is to the MRT station, the more expensive the rent.

text.traditional: 他很喜歡工作，事情越多，他越高興。
text.simplified: 他很喜欢工作，事情越多，他越高兴。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān gōngzuò, shìqíng yuè duō, tā yuè gāoxìng.
text.english: He really likes working. The more things he has to do, the happier he is.

summary: 越 ... 越 ... says that as the first action grows or shrinks in degree or number, the situation changes with it.
With one subject, put 越 before both verbs.
With two subjects, the second subject's state changes as the first subject does something more.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Pressing for an Answer with 到底
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 到底 in a question when the speaker is eager to know the answer.
grammarPages.explanation: “到底” is an adverb which is used in disjunctive questions except for those with final “嗎”, e.g., “到底要不要？” and “到底去不去？” It shows the emotion that the speaker is eager to know the answer. It can be placed before or after the Subject, but when the Subject is a question word, “到底” can only be placed in front of the Subject and used as an adverbial, e.g., “到底是誰偷了我的車？”
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “到底” is an adverb which is used in disjunctive questions except for those with final “嗎”, e.g., “到底要不要？” and “到底去不去？” It shows the emotion that the speaker is eager to know the answer. It can be placed before or after the Subject, but when the Subject is a question word, “到底” can only be placed in front of the Subject and used as an adverbial, e.g., “到底是誰偷了我的車？”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “到底” is an adverb which is used in disjunctive questions except for those with final “嗎”, e.g., “到底要不要？” and “到底去不去？” It shows the emotion that the speaker is eager to know the answer. It can be placed before or after the Subject, but when the Subject is a question word, “到底” can only be placed in front of the Subject and used as an adverbial, e.g., “到底是誰偷了我的車？”
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 到底 + question; 到底 + question word + clause

text.traditional: 我要訂位了，你明天到底要不要跟我們去 KTV？
text.simplified: 我要订位了，你明天到底要不要跟我们去 KTV？
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào dìngwèi le, nǐ míngtiān dàodǐ yào búyào gēn wǒmen qù KTV?
text.english: I’m about to make a reservation. Are you actually coming to KTV with us tomorrow, or not?

text.traditional: 到底要用幾張貼紙才換得到便利商店的禮物呢？
text.simplified: 到底要用几张贴纸才换得到便利商店的礼物呢？
text.pinyin: Dàodǐ yào yòng jǐ zhāng tiēzhǐ cái huàn de dào biànlì shāngdiàn de lǐwù ne?
text.english: How many stickers does it actually take to exchange for the convenience store’s gift?

text.traditional: 我不知道林老師到底住在學校前面還是後面的社區。
text.simplified: 我不知道林老师到底住在学校前面还是后面的社区。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào Lín lǎoshī dàodǐ zhù zài xuéxiào qiánmiàn háishì hòumiàn de shèqū.
text.english: I don’t know whether Teacher Lin actually lives in the neighborhood in front of the school or the one behind it.

summary: 到底 pushes for an answer and shows the speaker is eager to know.
Use it in choice questions like 要不要 or 去不去, or with a question word, but not with 嗎.
It can go before or after the subject, but if the subject is a question word, 到底 goes before it.

text.traditional: （美心戴著口罩，一直咳嗽）
text.simplified: （美心戴着口罩，一直咳嗽）
text.pinyin: (Měixīn dài zhe kǒuzhào, yìzhí késòu)
text.english: (Meixin wears a mask and keeps coughing.)

text.traditional: 妳怎麼了？生病了嗎？
text.simplified: 你怎么了？生病了吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zěnmele? Shēngbìng le ma?
text.english: What’s wrong with you? Are you feeling ill?

text.traditional: 我鼻子很不舒服，感冒一個星期了。不但頭痛，而且還拉肚子。等一下要去看病。
text.simplified: 我鼻子很不舒服，感冒一个星期了。不但头痛，而且还拉肚子。等一下要去看病。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bízi hěn bù shūfu, gǎnmào yíge xīngqí le. Búdàn tóutòng, érqiě hái lādùzi. Děng yíxià yào qù kànbìng.
text.english: There’s something weird with my nose. I caught a cold for a week. I not only have a headache, but also have diarrhea. I’m going to see a doctor later.

text.traditional: 我陪妳去吧！不過妳老是不運動，對身體不好喔！
text.simplified: 我陪你去吧！不过你老是不运动，对身体不好喔！
text.pinyin: Wǒ péi nǐ qù ba! Búguò nǐ lǎoshì bú yùndòng, duì shēntǐ bùhǎo o!
text.english: I’ll go with you! But you never exercise at all. This is not good for your body!

text.traditional: 我知道這樣的壞習慣應該改一改，可是……
text.simplified: 我知道这样的坏习惯应该改一改，可是……
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào zhèyàng de huài xíguàn yīnggāi gǎi yì gǎi, kěshì…
text.english: I know I should get out of those bad habits, but…

text.traditional: （良介走過來）
text.simplified: （良介走过来）
text.pinyin: (Liángjiè zǒu guò lái)
text.english: (Ryosuke comes over.)

text.traditional: 我要去健身房運動，要不要一起去？
text.simplified: 我要去健身房运动，要不要一起去？
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù jiànshēnfáng yùndòng, yào búyào yìqǐ qù?
text.english: I am going to the gym to work out. Would you like to go together?

text.traditional: 我從小就最討厭運動，每次上體育課，老師都要我們在操場上，一下子跑、一下子跳，我的腿跟脖子都痛死了。
text.simplified: 我从小就最讨厌运动，每次上体育课，老师都要我们在操场上，一下子跑、一下子跳，我的腿跟脖子都痛死了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù zuì tǎoyàn yùndòng, měi cì shàng tǐyù kè, lǎoshī dōu yào wǒmen zài cāochǎng shàng, yíxiàzi pǎo, yíxiàzi tiào, wǒ de tuǐ gēn bózi dōu tòng sǐ le.
text.english: I’ve hated sport since childhood. Everytime, when we had a PE class on the playground, the teacher asked us to run one minute and to jump the next. My legs and neck hurt terribly!

text.traditional: 妳太誇張了！體育課都是比較輕鬆的運動啊！
text.simplified: 你太夸张了！体育课都是比较轻松的运动啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ tài kuāzhāng le! Tǐyù kè dōu shì bǐjiào qīngsōng de yùndòng a!
text.english: You are exaggerating! The exercise in PE class is easier!

text.traditional: 可是有一次老師要我們跑一千五百公尺，跑到一半，我就覺得好像快死了，老師趕快叫救護車把我送到醫院，才救了我一命呢！
text.simplified: 可是有一次老师要我们跑一千五百公尺，跑到一半，我就觉得好像快死了，老师赶快叫救护车把我送到医院，才救了我一命呢！
text.pinyin: Kěshì yǒu yí cì lǎoshī yào wǒmen pǎo yìqiānwǔbǎi gōngchǐ, pǎo dào yíbàn, wǒ jiù juéde hǎoxiàng kuài sǐ le, lǎoshī gǎnkuài jiào jiùhùchē bǎ wǒ sòng dào yīyuàn, cái jiù le wǒ yí mìng ne!
text.english: But once, the teacher asked us to run 1500 meters. Having run half of it, I felt like I was about to die. The teacher quickly called an ambulance to take me to the hospital, which saved my life!

text.traditional: 現在我知道妳為什麼這麼討厭運動了！
text.simplified: 现在我知道你为什么这么讨厌运动了！
text.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ zhīdào nǐ wèishénme zhème tǎoyàn yùndòng le!
text.english: Now I know why you hate exercise so much!

text.traditional: 其實健身沒有妳想的那麼難，只要每天照健身教練說的做，就會越做越輕鬆的。
text.simplified: 其实健身没有你想的那么难，只要每天照健身教练说的做，就会越做越轻松的。
text.pinyin: Qíshí jiànshēn méiyǒu nǐ xiǎng de nàme nán, zhǐyào měitiān zhào jiànshēn jiàoliàn shuō de zuò, jiù huì yuè zuò yuè qīngsōng de.
text.english: Actually, working out is not as hard as you think. As long as you follow the instructions of your fitness coach every day, it should be getting easier and easier.

text.traditional: 我最近變胖了，健身能讓我瘦一點兒嗎？
text.simplified: 我最近变胖了，健身能让我瘦一点儿吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn biàn pàng le, jiànshēn néng ràng wǒ shòu yìdiǎnr ma?
text.english: I got fat recently. Can working out make me a bit thinner?

text.traditional: 健身也許能讓妳的體重減一、兩公斤，不過，最重要的目的是讓妳身體健康啊！
text.simplified: 健身也许能让你的体重减一、两公斤，不过，最重要的目的是让你身体健康啊！
text.pinyin: Jiànshēn yěxǔ néng ràng nǐ de tǐzhòng jiǎn yì, liǎng gōngjīn, búguò, zuì zhòngyào de mùdì shì ràng nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng a!
text.english: Working out may make your body weight decrease one or two kilos. However, the most important purpose is to make your body healthy!

text.traditional: 我覺得健身太累了，要我跳幾下還可以，跑操場就沒辦法了。
text.simplified: 我觉得健身太累了，要我跳几下还可以，跑操场就没办法了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiànshēn tài lèi le, yào wǒ tiào jǐ xià hái kěyǐ, pǎo cāochǎng jiù méibànfǎ le.
text.english: I think working out is too tiring. Jumping a few times is still OK for me, but there is no way I can run on the playground.

text.traditional: 對啊！我不是十七、八歲的年輕人，太累的運動我也不喜歡。
text.simplified: 对啊！我不是十七、八岁的年轻人，太累的运动我也不喜欢。
text.pinyin: Duì a! Wǒ búshì shíqī, bā suì de niánqīngrén, tài lèi de yùndòng wǒ yě bù xǐhuān.
text.english: Right! I am not a 17- or 18-year-old youngster. I also don’t like too exhausting exercises.

text.traditional: 妳還是年輕人啊！而且健身跟年紀沒什麼關係，男人、女人、老人、小孩都應該多運動。
text.simplified: 你还是年轻人啊！而且健身跟年纪没什么关系，男人、女人、老人、小孩都应该多运动。
text.pinyin: Nǐ háishì niánqīngrén a! Érqiě jiànshēn gēn niánjì méishénme guānxì, nánrén, nǚrén, lǎorén, xiǎohái dōu yīnggāi duō yùndòng.
text.english: You are still young! Also, working out and age are not related in any way. Men and women, the elderly and kids, all should exercise a lot.

text.traditional: 聽說常健身的人不能亂吃，應該吃什麼？要吃多少？他們都非常注意。
text.simplified: 听说常健身的人不能乱吃，应该吃什么？要吃多少？他们都非常注意。
text.pinyin: Tīngshuō cháng jiànshēn de rén bùnéng luàn chī, yīnggāi chī shénme? Yào chī duōshǎo? Tāmen dōu fēicháng zhùyì.
text.english: I heard that people who work out often cannot eat indiscriminately. What should they eat? How much should they eat? They all take notice of that.

text.traditional: 這個我知道！比如說，多吃新鮮的青菜、水果，少吃漢堡、薯條、餅乾。
text.simplified: 这个我知道！比如说，多吃新鲜的青菜、水果，少吃汉堡、薯条、饼干。
text.pinyin: Zhège wǒ zhīdào! Bǐrú shuō, duō chī xīnxiān de qīngcài, shuǐguǒ, shǎo chī hànbǎo, shǔtiáo, bǐnggān.
text.english: I know that! For example, they eat more fresh vegetables and fruits, and eat less hamburgers, French fries and cookies.

text.traditional: 飲食最好也要少油、少鹽、少糖。如果渴了，也別喝可樂，喝開水比較健康，還可以省錢呢！
text.simplified: 饮食最好也要少油、少盐、少糖。如果渴了，也别喝可乐，喝开水比较健康，还可以省钱呢！
text.pinyin: Yǐnshí zuìhǎo yě yào shǎo yóu, shǎo yán, shǎo táng. Rúguǒ kě le, yě bié hē kělè, hē kāishuǐ bǐjiào jiànkāng, hái kěyǐ shěngqián ne!
text.english: It is best to have less oil, less salt and less sugar diet. If you are thirsty, don’t drink cola. Drinking boiled water is more healthy. Besides, you can save some money!

text.traditional: 好的生活習慣也是很重要的，像我哥哥常常開夜車，早上來不及吃早餐就去上班了。
text.simplified: 好的生活习惯也是很重要的，像我哥哥常常开夜车，早上来不及吃早餐就去上班了。
text.pinyin: Hǎo de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shì hěn zhòngyào de, xiàng wǒ gēge chángcháng kāiyèchē, zǎoshàng láibùjí chī zǎocān jiù qù shàngbān le.
text.english: Good living habits are also important. For example, my elder brother often burns the midnight oil. In the morning he has little time to have breakfast before going to work.

text.traditional: 這樣對身體不好喔！三餐很重要，特別是早餐。我聽德國人說，早餐要吃得像國王一樣好。
text.simplified: 这样对身体不好喔！三餐很重要，特别是早餐。我听德国人说，早餐要吃得像国王一样好。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng duì shēntǐ bùhǎo o! Sāncān hěn zhòngyào, tèbié shì zǎocān. Wǒ tīng Déguó rén shuō, zǎocān yào chī de xiàng guówáng yíyàng hǎo.
text.english: This is not good for the body! The three meals are very important, especially breakfast. I heard the Germans say, “eat breakfast like a king!”

text.traditional: 說了這麼多，美心，妳到底要不要跟我們去健身呢？
text.simplified: 说了这么多，美心，你到底要不要跟我们去健身呢？
text.pinyin: Shuō le zhème duō, Měixīn, nǐ dàodǐ yào búyào gēn wǒmen qù jiànshēn ne?
text.english: We’ve talked so much, Meixin. After all, do you want to go to work out with us?

text.traditional: 要啊！等感冒好了就去，希望我們都可以健健康康地活到一百歲喔！哈哈哈！
text.simplified: 要啊！等感冒好了就去，希望我们都可以健健康康地活到一百岁喔！哈哈哈！
text.pinyin: Yào a! Děng gǎnmào hǎo le jiù qù, xīwàng wǒmen dōu kěyǐ jiàn jiànkāng kāng de huó dào yìbǎi suì o! Hāhāhā!
text.english: I will – when my cold gets better. I hope all of us can all live a healthy life until we are 100 years old! Hahaha!

text.traditional: 太好了！我就先訓練妳慢跑吧。
text.simplified: 太好了！我就先训练你慢跑吧。
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ jiù xiān xùnliàn nǐ mànpǎo ba.
text.english: Great! I’ll train you how to jog first.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · The Numerous Benefits of Sports

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: From Someone’s Point of View: 對…來說
grammarPages.learnerPromise: State someone’s opinion or attitude about an event.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “對 NP 來說” is used to show someone’s opinion or attitude toward a specific event.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “對 NP 來說” is used to show someone’s opinion or attitude toward a specific event.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “對 NP 來說” is used to show someone’s opinion or attitude toward a specific event.
grammarPages.pattern: 對 + NP + 來說，comment

columns.traditional: what it is like for them
columns.simplified: what it is like for them

text.traditional: 對老師來說，日本學生的漢字很少寫錯，可是聲調常說錯。
text.simplified: 对老师来说，日本学生的汉字很少写错，可是声调常说错。
text.pinyin: Duì lǎoshī lái shuō, Rìběn xuéshēng de Hànzì hěn shǎo xiě cuò, kěshì shēngdiào cháng shuō cuò.
text.english: As far as teachers are concerned, Japanese students rarely write Chinese characters incorrectly, but often say the tones incorrectly.

text.traditional: 對遊客來說，參觀當地的美術館或博物館，都是不錯的選擇。
text.simplified: 对游客来说，参观当地的美术馆或博物馆，都是不错的选择。
text.pinyin: Duì yóukè lái shuō, cānguān dāngdì de měishùguǎn huò bówùguǎn, dōu shì búcuò de xuǎnzé.
text.english: For tourists, visiting either the local art museum or the local museum is a good choice.

text.traditional: A：那個牌子很有名，一件外套一萬元，我覺得不貴。B：對你這個有錢人來說是不貴，可是對一般人來說貴得很。
text.simplified: A：那个牌子很有名，一件外套一万元，我觉得不贵。B：对你这个有钱人来说是不贵，可是对一般人来说贵得很。
text.pinyin: A: Nà ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yí jiàn wàitào yíwàn yuán, wǒ juéde bú guì. B: Duì nǐ zhè ge yǒu qián rén lái shuō shì bú guì, kěshì duì yìbānrén lái shuō guì de hěn.
text.english: A: That brand is famous. A coat costs NT$10,000, but I don’t think that’s expensive. B: For a rich person like you, it isn’t expensive, but for ordinary people it’s very expensive.

summary: 對 NP 來說 gives someone's opinion or attitude about a specific event.
Put the person between 對 and 來說, then give the comment.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Place 的話 at the end of the condition clause.
grammarPages.explanation: In Chinese, “的話” has the same function as “如果” and “要是” to form conditional sentences. However, “如果” and “要是” should be placed at the beginning of a sentence while “的話” should be placed at the end of the first clause. In some cases, using “要是” gives a stronger or even threatening tone than using “如果”. Both “如果” and “要是” can collocate with “的話”, and either can be left out. “的話” is a less formal expression.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In Chinese, “的話” has the same function as “如果” and “要是” to form conditional sentences. However, “如果” and “要是” should be placed at the beginning of a sentence while “的話” should be placed at the end of the first clause. In some cases, using “要是” gives a stronger or even threatening tone than using “如果”. Both “如果” and “要是” can collocate with “的話”, and either can be left out. “的話” is a less formal expression.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In Chinese, “的話” has the same function as “如果” and “要是” to form conditional sentences. However, “如果” and “要是” should be placed at the beginning of a sentence while “的話” should be placed at the end of the first clause. In some cases, using “要是” gives a stronger or even threatening tone than using “如果”. Both “如果” and “要是” can collocate with “的話”, and either can be left out. “的話” is a less formal expression.
grammarPages.pattern: (如果／要是) + condition + (的話)，result

text.traditional: 要是你明天不來（的話），記得要先告訴我！
text.simplified: 要是你明天不来（的话），记得要先告诉我！
text.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐ míngtiān bù lái (dehuà), jìde yào xiān gàosu wǒ!
text.english: If you aren’t coming tomorrow, remember to tell me first!

text.traditional: （如果）你常運動的話，心情一定會比較好。
text.simplified: （如果）你常运动的话，心情一定会比较好。
text.pinyin: (Rúguǒ) nǐ cháng yùndòng dehuà, xīnqíng yídìng huì bǐjiào hǎo.
text.english: If you exercise often, you’ll definitely be in a better mood.

text.traditional: （要是）你不保養那輛汽車的話，可能會有問題的！
text.simplified: （要是）你不保养那辆汽车的话，可能会有问题的！
text.pinyin: (Yàoshì) nǐ bù bǎoyǎng nà liàng qìchē dehuà, kěnéng huì yǒu wèntí de!
text.english: If you don’t maintain that car, there may be a problem!

summary: 的話 means if, like 如果 and 要是, but it goes at the end of the first part.
如果 and 要是 go at the start. They can be used with 的話, and either one can be left out.
要是 can sound stronger, even threatening, and 的話 is less formal.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleTraditional: 對……有／沒（有）幫助；有／沒（有）影響；有／沒（有）好處
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Helpful, Influential or Beneficial to Something
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe how something affects or benefits a person or thing.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern, in which “對” is followed by someone or something, indicates the Subject, often a thing, has influence on someone or something.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern, in which “對” is followed by someone or something, indicates the Subject, often a thing, has influence on someone or something.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern, in which “對” is followed by someone or something, indicates the Subject, often a thing, has influence on someone or something.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 對 + NP + 有／沒（有） + 幫助／影響／好處

text.traditional: 健身教練說，經常運動，對健康很有幫助。
text.simplified: 健身教练说，经常运动，对健康很有帮助。
text.pinyin: Jiànshēn jiàoliàn shuō, jīngcháng yùndòng, duì jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
text.english: The fitness coach says that exercising regularly is very good for your health.

text.traditional: 父母說的話，對我有很大的影響。
text.simplified: 父母说的话，对我有很大的影响。
text.pinyin: Fùmǔ shuō de huà, duì wǒ yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
text.english: What my parents say has a big influence on me.

text.traditional: 每天吃喝玩樂對你的將來沒有好處，你應該好好地利用時間。
text.simplified: 每天吃喝玩乐对你的将来没有好处，你应该好好地利用时间。
text.pinyin: Měitiān chīhēwánlè duì nǐ de jiānglái méi yǒu hǎochù, nǐ yīnggāi hǎohǎo de lìyòng shíjiān.
text.english: Eating, drinking, and having fun every day is not good for your future. You should make good use of your time.

summary: Says the subject, often a thing, helps, influences, or benefits someone or something.
Put 對 and the person or thing first, then 有 or 沒 plus 幫助, 影響 or 好處.

text.traditional: 對不運動的人來說，剛開始運動或許會覺得很辛苦，不過，要是願意每天跑步、打球，就會發現經常運動有很多好處。比如說，讓我們體力好、有精神、比較不容易生病。要是能跟家人或是朋友一起運動的話，不但身體會越來越健康，也會讓大家的關係更好呢！
text.simplified: 对不运动的人来说，刚开始运动或许会觉得很辛苦，不过，要是愿意每天跑步、打球，就会发现经常运动有很多好处。比如说，让我们体力好、有精神、比较不容易生病。要是能跟家人或是朋友一起运动的话，不但身体会越来越健康，也会让大家的关系更好呢！
text.pinyin: Duì bú yùndòng de rén lái shuō, gāng kāishǐ yùndòng huòxǔ huì juéde hěn xīnkǔ, búguò, yàoshì yuànyì měitiān pǎobù, dǎqiú, jiù huì fāxiàn jīngcháng yùndòng yǒu hěn duō hǎochù. Bǐrú shuō, ràng wǒmen tǐlì hǎo, yǒu jīngshén, bǐjiào bù róngyì shēngbìng. Yàoshì néng gēn jiārén huòshì péngyǒu yìqǐ yùndòng dehuà, búdàn shēntǐ huì yuèláiyuè jiànkāng, yě huì ràng dàjiā de guānxì gèng hǎo ne!
text.english: For those who don’t exercise, they might think that exercising is very hard in the beginning. However, if you are willing to run or play sports every day, you will find out that regular exercise brings many benefits. For example, it builds up our physical strength, makes us more energetic, and prevents us from getting sick easily. If you can exercise with your family or friends, not only will your body get healthier and healthier, but it can also improve your relationships!

text.traditional: 其實，運動對學習也有很大的幫助。在台灣，很多學生很用功，總是念書念到半夜才去睡覺，所以白天上課就沒有精神，容易打瞌睡。學校為了改善這個情況，除了讓學生睡午覺，每個星期也都會有一、兩堂體育課，學生去操場跑跑步、打打球，運動一下再繼續念書，一定比一直坐在教室裡好。
text.simplified: 其实，运动对学习也有很大的帮助。在台湾，很多学生很用功，总是念书念到半夜才去睡觉，所以白天上课就没有精神，容易打瞌睡。学校为了改善这个情况，除了让学生睡午觉，每个星期也都会有一、两堂体育课，学生去操场跑跑步、打打球，运动一下再继续念书，一定比一直坐在教室里好。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, yùndòng duì xuéxí yě yǒu hěn dà de bāngzhù. Zài Táiwān, hěn duō xuéshēng hěn yònggōng, zǒngshì niànshū niàn dào bànyè cái qù shuìjiào, suǒyǐ báitiān shàngkè jiù méiyǒu jīngshén, róngyì dǎ kēshuì. Xuéxiào wèile gǎishàn zhège qíngkuàng, chúle ràng xuéshēng shuì wǔjiào, měi ge xīngqí yě dōu huì yǒu yì, liǎng táng tǐyù kè, xuéshēng qù cāochǎng pǎo pǎobù, dǎ da qiú, yùndòng yíxià zài jìxù niànshū, yídìng bǐ yìzhí zuò zài jiàoshì lǐ hǎo.
text.english: In fact, exercise is of great help to learning. In Taiwan many students are very hard-working. They always study until midnight and go to bed late, so they have no energy and doze off easily in class during the day. In order to improve this situation, the school allows students to take a midday nap and organizes one or two PE classes a week. Students run and play balls on the playground, and exercise a bit before going back to studying. It’s certainly better than sitting in a classroom all the time.

text.traditional: 醫生也常建議病人多運動，因為運動能幫助他們恢復身體和心理的健康。如果你覺得心情不好，就出門去散散步、游游泳，或是在家裡做做家事，活動一下身體。這樣，也許就能把難過的事情忘了。
text.simplified: 医生也常建议病人多运动，因为运动能帮助他们恢复身体和心理的健康。如果你觉得心情不好，就出门去散散步、游游泳，或是在家里做做家事，活动一下身体。这样，也许就能把难过的事情忘了。
text.pinyin: Yīshēng yě cháng jiànyì bìngrén duō yùndòng, yīnwèi yùndòng néng bāngzhù tāmen huīfù shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng. Rúguǒ nǐ juéde xīnqíng bùhǎo, jiù chūmén qù sàn sànbù, yóu yóuyǒng, huòshì zài jiālǐ zuò zuò jiāshì, huódòng yíxià shēntǐ. Zhèyàng, yěxǔ jiù néng bǎ nánguò de shìqíng wàngle.
text.english: Also, doctors often advise their patients to exercise more, because exercising can help them regain physical and mental health. If you have a bad mood, go out for a walk, swim, or do some housework at home to move your body for a while. This way you may forget all the sad things.

text.traditional: 運動有這麼多的好處，讓我們脫下牛仔褲、穿上運動服，一起去運動吧！
text.simplified: 运动有这么多的好处，让我们脱下牛仔裤、穿上运动服，一起去运动吧！
text.pinyin: Yùndòng yǒu zhème duō de hǎochù, ràng wǒmen tuōxià niúzǎikù, chuān shàng yùndòngfú, yìqǐ qù yùndòng ba!
text.english: Exercising has so many benefits. Let’s take our jeans off, put on some sportswear, and go exercise together!

items.title: Grammar 1–5 · Which Club Would You Like to Join?

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Which Club Would You Like to Join?
grammarPages.titleTraditional: PW + V 了 + N / PW + V 著 + N
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Existential Sentences with 了 and 著
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what exists in a place and whether it is standing, sitting, or arranged there.
grammarPages.explanation: “PW+V 了+N /PW+V 著+N” indicates something/ some things exist(s) in a certain place. The verbs used in this pattern can be posture verb and non-posture verb. Posture verbs are used to describe the posture of a human or an animal existing in that place, such as “坐”, “站”, “躺”, “蹲”, etc. Non-posture verbs are used to describe the manner or action some objects are placed, such as “放”, “貼”, “掛”, “停”, “寫”, “畫”, “拿”, etc.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “PW+V 了+N /PW+V 著+N” indicates something/ some things exist(s) in a certain place. The verbs used in this pattern can be posture verb and non-posture verb. Posture verbs are used to describe the posture of a human or an animal existing in that place, such as “坐”, “站”, “躺”, “蹲”, etc. Non-posture verbs are used to describe the manner or action some objects are placed, such as “放”, “貼”, “掛”, “停”, “寫”, “畫”, “拿”, etc.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “PW+V 了+N /PW+V 著+N” indicates something/ some things exist(s) in a certain place. The verbs used in this pattern can be posture verb and non-posture verb. Posture verbs are used to describe the posture of a human or an animal existing in that place, such as “坐”, “站”, “躺”, “蹲”, etc. Non-posture verbs are used to describe the manner or action some objects are placed, such as “放”, “貼”, “掛”, “停”, “寫”, “畫”, “拿”, etc.
grammarPages.pattern: Place word + V 了 + N / Place word + V 著 + N

text.traditional: 社區的大樓前面站了很多人。
text.simplified: 社区的大楼前面站了很多人。
text.english: There are many people standing in front of the apartment building in the community.
text.pinyin: Shèqū de dàlóu qiánmiàn zhàn le hěn duō rén.

text.traditional: 冰箱裡面放了媽媽買的花蓮名產。
text.simplified: 冰箱里面放了妈妈买的花莲名产。
text.english: Inside the refrigerator are the Hualien specialties that Mom bought.
text.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐmiàn fàng le māma mǎi de Huālián míngchǎn.

text.traditional: 便利商店門口貼著這次活動的海報。
text.simplified: 便利商店门口贴着这次活动的海报。
text.english: A poster for this event is posted at the convenience store entrance.
text.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn ménkǒu tiē zhe zhè cì huódòng de hǎibào.

text.traditional: 朋友寄來的明信片上面寫著他旅遊的心情。
text.simplified: 朋友寄来的明信片上面写着他旅游的心情。
text.english: The postcard my friend sent describes how he felt about the trip.
text.pinyin: Péngyǒu jì lái de míngxìnpiàn shàngmiàn xiě zhe tā lǚyóu de xīnqíng.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 了 and 著 to say what is in each picture.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: 請用「PW+V 了+N / PW+V 著+N」說說這張圖片有什麼。
summary: Place word + verb + 了 or 著 + noun says that something exists in a place.
Posture verbs tell how a person or animal is in that place, such as 坐 and 站.
Other verbs tell how things are put there, such as 放 and 掛.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Which Club Would You Like to Join?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what someone is or is not interested in.
grammarPages.explanation: “感興趣” is used to show the subject’s interests and willingness to have further acquaintance with something.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “感興趣” is used to show the subject’s interests and willingness to have further acquaintance with something.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “感興趣” is used to show the subject’s interests and willingness to have further acquaintance with something.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 對 + Noun / Verb phrase +（不）感興趣

text.traditional: 白小姐很愛化妝，對現在最流行的化妝品很感興趣。
text.simplified: 白小姐很爱化妆，对现在最流行的化妆品很感兴趣。
text.english: Miss Bai loves putting on makeup and is very interested in the most fashionable cosmetics.
text.pinyin: Bái xiǎojiě hěn ài huàzhuāng, duì xiànzài zuì liúxíng de huàzhuāngpǐn hěn gǎnxìngqù.

text.traditional: 我喜歡幫助別人，所以對去醫院服務的事非常感興趣。
text.simplified: 我喜欢帮助别人，所以对去医院服务的事非常感兴趣。
text.english: I like helping other people, so I am very interested in volunteering at hospitals.
text.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān bāngzhù biérén, suǒyǐ duì qù yīyuàn fúwù de shì fēicháng gǎnxìngqù.

text.traditional: 林先生很喜歡張小姐，可是張小姐對他一點兒都不感興趣。
text.simplified: 林先生很喜欢张小姐，可是张小姐对他一点儿都不感兴趣。
text.english: Mr. Lin really likes Miss Zhang, but Miss Zhang is not interested in him at all.
text.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng hěn xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, kěshì Zhāng xiǎojiě duì tā yìdiǎnr dōu bù gǎnxìngqù.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Say whether you are interested in each activity and why.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: 你對下面這些事感興趣嗎？為什麼？請用「對……感興趣」或「對……不感興趣」回答。
summary: 對 ... 感興趣 says the subject is interested in something and wants to know it better.
Put what you are interested in between 對 and 感興趣. It can be a noun or a verb phrase.
Put 不 before 感興趣 to say not interested.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Which Club Would You Like to Join?
grammarPages.titleTraditional: V 出來：V 出來了／沒 V 出來／V 得出來／V 不出來
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use a sensory verb to tell whether you can recognize something, or 想出來 to come up with an idea.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “V 出來”, when V is a sensory verb, such as “看”, “聽”, “吃”, “喝”, means to make out by seeing, hearing, eating and drinking, etc. It suggests whether one can realize or distinguish something by performing a certain sensory action. When the verb is “想” or executive verb, this pattern indicates a development from nothing. “想出來” means to come up with (an idea).
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “V 出來”, when V is a sensory verb, such as “看”, “聽”, “吃”, “喝”, means to make out by seeing, hearing, eating and drinking, etc. It suggests whether one can realize or distinguish something by performing a certain sensory action. When the verb is “想” or executive verb, this pattern indicates a development from nothing. “想出來” means to come up with (an idea).
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “V 出來”, when V is a sensory verb, such as “看”, “聽”, “吃”, “喝”, means to make out by seeing, hearing, eating and drinking, etc. It suggests whether one can realize or distinguish something by performing a certain sensory action. When the verb is “想” or executive verb, this pattern indicates a development from nothing. “想出來” means to come up with (an idea).
grammarPages.pattern: V + 出來（了）／沒 + V + 出來／V + 得出來／V + 不出來

text.traditional: 到底是誰打電話給我的？他的聲音，你聽不出來嗎？
text.simplified: 到底是谁打电话给我的？他的声音，你听不出来吗？
text.english: Who on earth called me? Can’t you recognize his voice?
text.pinyin: Dàodǐ shì shéi dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ de? Tā de shēngyīn, nǐ tīng bù chūlái ma?

text.traditional: 他上班又遲到了，讓老闆很生氣，大家都看得出來。
text.simplified: 他上班又迟到了，让老板很生气，大家都看得出来。
text.english: He was late to work again, which made the boss very angry. Everyone could tell.
text.pinyin: Tā shàngbān yòu chídào le, ràng lǎobǎn hěn shēngqì, dàjiā dōu kàn de chū lái.

text.traditional: A：這是什麼茶，你們喝得出來喝不出來？B：我一喝就喝出來了！這是紅茶。C：真厲害！我還是喝不出來。
text.simplified: A：这是什么茶，你们喝得出来喝不出来？B：我一喝就喝出来了！这是红茶。C：真厉害！我还是喝不出来。
text.english: A: What kind of tea is this? Can you tell by tasting it? B: I could tell as soon as I drank it! It is black tea. C: Amazing! I still can’t tell.
text.pinyin: A: Zhè shì shénme chá, nǐmen hē de chūlái hē bù chūlái? B: Wǒ yì hē jiù hē chūlái le! Zhè shì hóngchá. C: Zhēn lìhài! Wǒ háishì hē bù chūlái.

text.traditional: 這句義大利文的中文翻譯很難，我想了很久，才想出來怎麼翻譯。
text.simplified: 这句义大利文的中文翻译很难，我想了很久，才想出来怎么翻译。
text.english: The Chinese translation of this Italian sentence is difficult. I thought for a long time before figuring out how to translate it.
text.pinyin: Zhè jù Yìdàlì wén de Zhōngwén fānyì hěn nán, wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, cái xiǎng chū lái zěnme fānyì.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use V 出來 to answer each prompt.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete each conversation using V 出來.
summary: After a verb of the senses like 看 or 聽, 出來 means you can make something out by that sense.
After 想 or an action verb, it means something comes from nothing, so 想出來 means to come up with an idea.
Put 得 or 不 between the verb and 出來 to say you can or can't.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Which Club Would You Like to Join?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Pause on a topic while deciding what to say next.
grammarPages.explanation: “嘛” is used to take a pause in a sentence when the speaker is thinking about what to say next about the topic mentioned.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “嘛” is used to take a pause in a sentence when the speaker is thinking about what to say next about the topic mentioned.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “嘛” is used to take a pause in a sentence when the speaker is thinking about what to say next about the topic mentioned.
grammarPages.pattern: Topic + 嘛…… + comment

text.traditional: A：你喜歡看什麼電視節目？影集還是連續劇？B：我喜歡看影集，連續劇嘛……我真的不感興趣。
text.simplified: A：你喜欢看什么电视节目？影集还是连续剧？B：我喜欢看影集，连续剧嘛……我真的不感兴趣。
text.english: A: What TV shows do you like to watch, series or dramas? B: I like watching series. As for dramas…I’m really not interested.
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ xǐhuān kàn shénme diànshì jiémù? Yǐngjí háishì liánxùjù? B: Wǒ xǐhuān kàn yǐngjí, liánxùjù ma… wǒ zhēnde bù gǎnxìngqù.

text.traditional: A：要不要一起去夜市？我想試試臭豆腐。B：我也想去夜市，可是臭豆腐嘛……你自己吃就好。
text.simplified: A：要不要一起去夜市？我想试试臭豆腐。B：我也想去夜市，可是臭豆腐嘛……你自己吃就好。
text.english: A: Want to go to the night market together? I want to try stinky tofu. B: I want to go too, but as for stinky tofu…you can eat that yourself.
text.pinyin: A: Yào búyào yìqǐ qù yèshì? Wǒ xiǎng shì shì chòu dòufǔ. B: Wǒ yě xiǎng qù yèshì, kěshì chòu dòufǔ ma… nǐ zìjǐ chī jiù hǎo.

text.traditional: A：美國歷史這門課的考試，你考得怎麼樣？B：筆試考得不錯，口試嘛……我聽不懂問題，所以說得不好。
text.simplified: A：美国历史这门课的考试，你考得怎么样？B：笔试考得不错，口试嘛……我听不懂问题，所以说得不好。
text.english: A: How did you do on the exam for American history? B: I did well on the written test. As for the oral test…I didn’t understand the questions, so I didn’t speak well.
text.pinyin: A: Měiguó lìshǐ zhè mén kè de kǎoshì, nǐ kǎo de zěnmeyàng? B: Bǐshì kǎo de búcuò, kǒushì ma… wǒ tīng bù dǒng wèntí, suǒyǐ shuō de bùhǎo.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 嘛 to pause on the topic before adding your comment.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Use 嘛 to pause on each topic before continuing.
summary: 嘛 marks the topic and gives a pause while the speaker thinks about what to say next about it.
Put 嘛 right after the topic, then add the comment.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Which Club Would You Like to Join?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that two people or things share the same item, time, place, or situation.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “同+一+M” is used to describe different subjects having the same situation, and this situation can be the same object, time and location, etc.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “同+一+M” is used to describe different subjects having the same situation, and this situation can be the same object, time and location, etc.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “同+一+M” is used to describe different subjects having the same situation, and this situation can be the same object, time and location, etc.
grammarPages.pattern: 同 + 一 + Measure word（+ Noun）

text.traditional: 我跟妹妹都喜歡喝同一種飲料。
text.simplified: 我跟妹妹都喜欢喝同一种饮料。
text.english: My younger sister and I both like drinking the same kind of beverage.
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn mèimei dōu xǐhuān hē tóng yì zhǒng yǐnliào.

text.traditional: 他們兩個人是鄰居，住在同一棟公寓。
text.simplified: 他们两个人是邻居，住在同一栋公寓。
text.english: The two of them are neighbors and live in the same apartment building.
text.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng ge rén shì línjū, zhù zài tóng yí dòng gōngyù.

text.traditional: 這個學期，我弟弟跟山本良介在同一班上英文會話課。
text.simplified: 这个学期，我弟弟跟山本良介在同一班上英文会话课。
text.english: This semester, my younger brother and Yamamoto Ryosuke are in the same English conversation class.
text.pinyin: Zhège xuéqí, wǒ dìdi gēn Shānběn Liángjiè zài tóng yì bān shàng Yīngwén huìhuà kè.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Rewrite each sentence with 同 + 一 + M (+ N).
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: 改寫句子。Rewrite the sentences with 同+一+M (+N).
summary: 同 + 一 + a measure word says that different people or things share the same situation.
The shared thing can be the same object, time, location and so on.
A noun can follow the measure word, but it is not required.

dialogue.title: 你想參加哪一個社團？
grammarFocus: PW + V 了 + N / PW + V 著 + N

text.traditional: （以凡跟良介在校園裡）
text.simplified: （以凡跟良介在校园里）
text.pinyin: (Yǐfán gēn Liángjiè zài xiàoyuán lǐ)
text.english: (Yifan and Ryosuke are on campus.)

text.traditional: 最近校園裡擺了很多攤子，攤子前面站了不少學生，他們在做什麼啊？
text.simplified: 最近校园里摆了很多摊子，摊子前面站了不少学生，他们在做什么啊？
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn xiàoyuán lǐ bǎi le hěn duō tānzi, tānzi qiánmiàn zhàn le bùshǎo xuéshēng, tāmen zài zuò shénme a?
text.english: Recently, many stalls have been set up on campus. In front of the stalls stand a lot of students. What are they doing?

text.traditional: 每個學期開學的時候，學生社團的社員都會給新生介紹自己的社團，讓新生知道他們有什麼活動。
text.simplified: 每个学期开学的时候，学生社团的社员都会给新生介绍自己的社团，让新生知道他们有什么活动。
text.pinyin: Měi ge xuéqí kāixué de shíhòu, xuéshēng shètuán de shèyuán dōu huì gěi xīnshēng jièshào zìjǐ de shètuán, ràng xīnshēng zhīdào tāmen yǒu shénme huódòng.
text.english: At the beginning of every semester, members of each student club introduce their clubs to new students, and let new students know what activities their clubs have.

text.traditional: 聽起來很有意思，我們過去看看吧！
text.simplified: 听起来很有意思，我们过去看看吧！
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn yǒuyìsi, wǒmen guòqù kànkan ba!
text.english: Sounds very interesting. Let’s go take a look!

text.traditional: （兩個人把攤子都看了一遍以後）
text.simplified: （两个人把摊子都看了一遍以后）
text.pinyin: (Liǎng ge rén bǎ tānzi dōu kàn le yí biàn yǐhòu)
text.english: (After taking a look at each of the stalls once.)

text.traditional: 這麼多社團，我不知道怎麼選擇。
text.simplified: 这么多社团，我不知道怎么选择。
text.pinyin: Zhème duō shètuán, wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme xuǎnzé.
text.english: There are so many student clubs. I don’t know how to choose.

text.traditional: 對啊！每個社團看起來都很吸引人，真的很難立刻決定。除了鋼琴社，我也想參加書法社和中國功夫社。
text.simplified: 对啊！每个社团看起来都很吸引人，真的很难立刻决定。除了钢琴社，我也想参加书法社和中国功夫社。
text.pinyin: Duì a! Měi ge shètuán kànqǐlái dōu hěn xīyǐn rén, zhēnde hěn nán lìkè juédìng. Chúle gāngqín shè, wǒ yě xiǎng cānjiā shūfǎ shè hé Zhōngguó gōngfu shè.
text.english: Yes! Every club looks very attractive, and it’s really hard to decide right away. Besides the piano club, I also want to participate in the calligraphy and Chinese Kungfu clubs.

text.traditional: 看不出來你對中華文化這麼感興趣！
text.simplified: 看不出来你对中华文化这么感兴趣！
text.pinyin: Kàn bù chū lái nǐ duì Zhōnghuá Wénhuà zhème gǎnxìngqù!
text.english: I can’t tell that you are so interested in Chinese culture!

text.traditional: 我覺得中國書法是一種藝術。參加書法社可以讓我認識更多漢字。
text.simplified: 我觉得中国书法是一种艺术。参加书法社可以让我认识更多汉字。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Zhōngguó shūfǎ shì yì zhǒng yìshù. Cānjiā shūfǎ shè kěyǐ ràng wǒ rènshì gèng duō Hànzì.
text.english: I think that Chinese calligraphy is a kind of art. Joining the calligraphy club allows me to learn more Chinese characters.

text.traditional: 那中國功夫社呢？
text.simplified: 那中国功夫社呢？
text.pinyin: Nà Zhōngguó gōngfu shè ne?
text.english: What about Chinese Kungfu club then?

text.traditional: 中國功夫社嘛……我覺得中國功夫好厲害，如果學會了就可以保護自己，讓自己變得更勇敢。你呢？
text.simplified: 中国功夫社嘛……我觉得中国功夫好厉害，如果学会了就可以保护自己，让自己变得更勇敢。你呢？
text.pinyin: Zhōngguó gōngfu shè ma… wǒ juéde Zhōngguó gōngfu hǎo lìhài, rúguǒ xuéhuì le jiù kěyǐ bǎohù zìjǐ, ràng zìjǐ biàn de gèng yǒnggǎn. Nǐ ne?
text.english: Chinese Kungfu club… I think Chinese Kungfu is amazing. If I learn it, I can protect myself and become braver. And you?

text.traditional: 我想參加吉他社或是愛心服務社。
text.simplified: 我想参加吉他社或是爱心服务社。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cānjiā jítā shè huòshì àixīn fúwù shè.
text.english: I want to join the guitar club or the charity service club.

text.traditional: 這兩個社團非常不一樣，你為什麼都有興趣？
text.simplified: 这两个社团非常不一样，你为什么都有兴趣？
text.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge shètuán fēicháng bù yíyàng, nǐ wèishénme dōu yǒu xìngqù?
text.english: These two clubs are very different. Why are you interested in both of them?

text.traditional: 我以前學過吉他，但是太久沒練習，很多技巧都忘了，我想複習複習。愛心服務社嘛……
text.simplified: 我以前学过吉他，但是太久没练习，很多技巧都忘了，我想复习复习。爱心服务社嘛……
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián xué guo jítā, dànshì tài jiǔ méi liànxí, hěn duō jìqiǎo dōu wàngle, wǒ xiǎng fùxí fùxí. Àixīn fúwù shè ma…
text.english: I used to learn how to play the guitar, but I haven’t practiced it for too long. I’ve already forgotten a lot of skills, so I want to review them a bit. As for the charity service club…

text.traditional: 我知道，你想幫助需要幫助的人。
text.simplified: 我知道，你想帮助需要帮助的人。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, nǐ xiǎng bāngzhù xūyào bāngzhù de rén.
text.english: I know! You want to help the people in need.

text.traditional: 沒錯，我們都生活在同一個地球上，本來就應該互相幫助。
text.simplified: 没错，我们都生活在同一个地球上，本来就应该互相帮助。
text.pinyin: Méicuò, wǒmen dōu shēnghuó zài tóng yíge dìqiú shàng, běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
text.english: Right. We all live on the same planet Earth. Of course we should help each other.

text.traditional: 沒想到你想得這麼多！那麼要跟誰談戀愛，你想好了沒有？
text.simplified: 没想到你想得这么多！那么要跟谁谈恋爱，你想好了没有？
text.pinyin: Méixiǎngdào nǐ xiǎng de zhème duō! Nàme yào gēn shéi tán liàn'ài, nǐ xiǎng hǎo le méiyǒu?
text.english: I didn't expect that you think this much! Then have you decided who you're to be in love with?

text.traditional: 你別開玩笑了！
text.simplified: 你别开玩笑了！
text.pinyin: Nǐ bié kāiwánxiào le!
text.english: Don't be kidding me!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 等 to show a category total or that a list has more examples.
grammarPages.explanation: In Chinese, the word “等” has two functions. Firstly, it can be placed before a number that marks the total of items mentioned, or before a word that is the hypernym (category) for the items mentioned. On the other hand, it can be used at the end of a list to show there are still a lot of examples of the same kind.

grammarPages.pattern: Examples + 等 +（total / category / etc.）

text.traditional: 請在這裡寫下你的姓名、國家、出生日期等資料。
text.simplified: 请在这里写下你的姓名、国家、出生日期等资料。
text.english: Please write your name, country, date of birth, and other information here.
text.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ xiě xià nǐ de xìngmíng, guójiā, chūshēng rìqí děng zīliào.

text.traditional: 我哥哥喜愛旅遊，他去過日本、英國、法國等三個國家。
text.simplified: 我哥哥喜爱旅游，他去过日本、英国、法国等三个国家。
text.english: My older brother loves traveling. He has visited three countries: Japan, the UK, and France.
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge xǐ'ài lǚyóu, tā qù guo Rìběn, Yīngguó, Fǎguó děng sān ge guójiā.

text.traditional: 學校的社團像鋼琴社、吉他社、書法社等，都有很多社員。
text.simplified: 学校的社团像钢琴社、吉他社、书法社等，都有很多社员。
text.english: The school’s clubs, such as the piano, guitar, and calligraphy clubs, all have many members.
text.pinyin: Xuéxiào de shètuán xiàng gāngqín shè, jítā shè, shūfǎ shè děng, dōu yǒu hěn duō shèyuán.

summary: After a list of examples, 等 can sum them up with a number for the total or a word for the category.
Put 等 at the end of a list to show there are many more of the same kind.

grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “中” means “inside” instead of “middle”. The pattern “從……中” indicates someone learns about a situation, deals with something, or gets benefits from something.

text.traditional: 醫生從檢查報告中了解病人的情況。
text.simplified: 医生从检查报告中了解病人的情况。
text.english: The doctor learns about the patient’s condition from the examination report.
text.pinyin: Yīshēng cóng jiǎnchá bàogào zhōng liǎojiě bìngrén de qíngkuàng.

text.traditional: 我們可以從生活中得到不少寶貴的經驗。
text.simplified: 我们可以从生活中得到不少宝贵的经验。
text.english: We can gain many valuable experiences from life.
text.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ cóng shēnghuó zhōng dédào bùshǎo bǎoguì de jīngyàn.

text.traditional: 從他說的這些話中，我聽不出來他是高興還是難過。
text.simplified: 从他说的这些话中，我听不出来他是高兴还是难过。
text.english: From what he said, I can’t tell whether he is happy or sad.
text.pinyin: Cóng tā shuō de zhèxiē huà zhōng, wǒ tīng bù chūlái tā shì gāoxìng háishì nánguò.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Rewrite each sentence with 從……中.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: 改寫句子。Rewrite the sentences with 從……中.
summary: 從 ... 中 says someone learns about a situation, deals with something, or gets benefits from something.
In this pattern, 中 means inside, not middle.

dialogue.title: 社團活動對山本良介的影響

text.traditional: 山本良介來台灣以後，參加了愛心服務社。社團每個月都會安排兩次活動，利用週末到一些地方去服務。
text.simplified: 山本良介来台湾以后，参加了爱心服务社。社团每个月都会安排两次活动，利用周末到一些地方去服务。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, cānjiā le àixīn fúwù shè. Shètuán měi ge yuè dōu huì ānpái liǎng cì huódòng, lìyòng zhōumò dào yìxiē dìfāng qù fúwù.
text.english: After coming to Taiwan, Yamamoto Ryosuke joined the charity service club. Every month, the club organizes two events and uses the time on weekends to go to some places to help people.

text.traditional: 社員們會到安養院去幫老人打掃環境、擦窗戶、洗廁所、刷馬桶，然後再陪他們聊聊天。他們也會到育幼院去照顧孩子，教比較小的孩子刷牙、穿衣服，陪比較大的孩子讀書、做功課。有時候也給他們上美術課，或是帶他們到外邊運動。上過護理課的社員，就可以到醫院去陪病人檢查身體，幫他們處理掛號、住院、出院等問題，或是到病房關心病人和他們的家人。這些經驗讓良介有不少收穫。
text.simplified: 社员们会到安养院去帮老人打扫环境、擦窗户、洗厕所、刷马桶，然后再陪他们聊聊天。他们也会到育幼院去照顾孩子，教比较小的孩子刷牙、穿衣服，陪比较大的孩子读书、做功课。有时候也给他们上美术课，或是带他们到外边运动。上过护理课的社员，就可以到医院去陪病人检查身体，帮他们处理挂号、住院、出院等问题，或是到病房关心病人和他们的家人。这些经验让良介有不少收获。
text.pinyin: Shèyuán men huì dào ānyǎng yuàn qù bāng lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng, cā chuānghù, xǐ cèsuǒ, shuā mǎtǒng, ránhòu zài péi tāmen liáo liáotiān. Tāmen yě huì dào yùyòuyuàn qù zhàogù háizi, jiāo bǐjiào xiǎo de háizi shuāyá, chuān yīfu, péi bǐjiào dà de háizi dúshū, zuò gōngkè. Yǒushíhòu yě gěi tāmen shàng měishù kè, huòshì dài tāmen dào wàibiān yùndòng. Shàng guo hùlǐ kè de shèyuán, jiù kěyǐ dào yīyuàn qù péi bìngrén jiǎnchá shēntǐ, bāng tāmen chǔlǐ guàhào, zhùyuàn, chūyuàn děng wèntí, huòshì dào bìngfáng guānxīn bìngrén hé tāmen de jiārén. Zhèxiē jīngyàn ràng Liángjiè yǒu bùshǎo shōuhuò.
text.english: Members of the club would go to elderly nursing homes to help the elderly clean up the environment, wipe windows, wash the bathrooms, brush the toilets, and then chat with them. They would also go to children’s homes to look after the children. They teach the younger children how to brush their teeth or put on their clothes, and accompany the older children in studying or doing homework. Sometimes they organize fine art lessons for them, or take them outside to exercise. Furthermore, members who have attended nursing courses can go to hospitals to accompany patients in medical examinations and help them handle issues such as registration, hospitalization and discharge, or go into wards to show concern for patients and their relatives. These experiences benefit Ryosuke a lot.

text.traditional: 以前良介每天只知道念書，對很多事情都不感興趣，常去的地方只有學校、書店或是圖書館。因為他極重視考試的成績，對他來說，只要成績好，就代表會有一個美好的未來。不過，參加了幾次愛心服務以後，他發現自己成長了不少。從服務中得到的經驗，好像比從課本中學到的更寶貴呢！所以良介告訴自己，畢業以後，他還要繼續做這個極有意義的工作。
text.simplified: 以前良介每天只知道念书，对很多事情都不感兴趣，常去的地方只有学校、书店或是图书馆。因为他极重视考试的成绩，对他来说，只要成绩好，就代表会有一个美好的未来。不过，参加了几次爱心服务以后，他发现自己成长了不少。从服务中得到的经验，好像比从课本中学到的更宝贵呢！所以良介告诉自己，毕业以后，他还要继续做这个极有意义的工作。
text.pinyin: Yǐqián Liángjiè měitiān zhǐ zhīdào niànshū, duì hěn duō shìqíng dōu bù gǎnxìngqù, cháng qù de dìfāng zhǐyǒu xuéxiào, shūdiàn huòshì túshūguǎn. Yīnwèi tā jí zhòngshì kǎoshì de chéngjī, duì tā lái shuō, zhǐyào chéngjī hǎo, jiù dàibiǎo huì yǒu yíge měihǎo de wèilái. Búguò, cānjiā le jǐ cì àixīn fúwù yǐhòu, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo. Cóng fúwù zhōng dédào de jīngyàn, hǎoxiàng bǐ cóng kèběn zhōng xué dào de gèng bǎoguì ne! Suǒyǐ Liángjiè gàosu zìjǐ, bìyè yǐhòu, tā háiyào jìxù zuò zhège jí yǒu yìyì de gōngzuò.
text.english: Before, what Ryosuke did was just studying every day. He wasn’t interested in many things. The places where he went often were only the school, bookstores and libraries. He paid very great attention to the scores of exams. For him, he thought that grades mean everything. As long as the grades are good, it means a bright future. However, after participating in charity service several times, he realized he grew a lot. The experience he gained through service seems to be more valuable than what he learned from textbooks! So Ryosuke tells himself: After graduation, he will continue to do this extremely meaningful work.

items.title: Grammar 1–6 · A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?

dialogue.title: 對話 · 小職員？大老闆？ · A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?

text.traditional: （美心跟可欣在教室外面聊天）
text.simplified: （美心跟可欣在教室外面聊天）
text.pinyin: (Měixīn gēn Kěxīn zài jiàoshì wàimiàn liáotiān)
text.english: (Meixin and Kexin are chatting outside the classroom.)

text.traditional: 我大哥今年六月就大學畢業了，他計畫去英國念研究所。
text.simplified: 我大哥今年六月就大学毕业了，他计划去英国念研究所。
text.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē jīnnián liùyuè jiù dàxué bìyè le, tā jìhuà qù Yīngguó niàn yánjiùsuǒ.
text.english: My eldest brother is going to graduate this June. He is planning to study in a graduate school in England.

text.traditional: 他想研究什麼呢？
text.simplified: 他想研究什么呢？
text.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yánjiù shénme ne?
text.english: What does he want to research?

text.traditional: 他對藝術、文化很有興趣，英國的大學有很多這樣的課程，等收到學校的通知，就要去留學了。
text.simplified: 他对艺术、文化很有兴趣，英国的大学有很多这样的课程，等收到学校的通知，就要去留学了。
text.pinyin: Tā duì yìshù, wénhuà hěn yǒu xìngqù, Yīngguó de dàxué yǒu hěn duō zhèyàng de kèchéng, děng shōudào xuéxiào de tōngzhī, jiùyào qù liúxué le.
text.english: He is interested in art and culture. The universities in England have many courses like that. After he receives a notification, he will leave to study abroad in June.

text.traditional: 出國念書很好啊！念了研究所，將來也比較容易找到工作。
text.simplified: 出国念书很好啊！念了研究所，将来也比较容易找到工作。
text.pinyin: Chūguó niànshū hěn hǎo a! Niàn le yánjiùsuǒ, jiānglái yě bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào gōngzuò.
text.english: Studying abroad is really good! Also, after getting the Master’s degree, it will be easier to find a job in the future.

text.traditional: 聽說有些念廣告或是服裝設計的人，還沒畢業就找到工作了。
text.simplified: 听说有些念广告或是服装设计的人，还没毕业就找到工作了。
text.pinyin: Tīngshuō yǒuxiē niàn guǎnggào huòshì fúzhuāng shèjì de rén, háiméi bìyè jiù zhǎodào gōngzuò le.
text.english: I heard that some people who study advertising or fashion design find a job even before graduation.

text.traditional: 好厲害喔！不過，我覺得興趣也很重要，如果工作太無聊，我一定會想換工作的。
text.simplified: 好厉害喔！不过，我觉得兴趣也很重要，如果工作太无聊，我一定会想换工作的。
text.pinyin: Hǎo lìhài o! Búguò, wǒ juéde xìngqù yě hěn zhòngyào, rúguǒ gōngzuò tài wúliáo, wǒ yídìng huì xiǎng huàn gōngzuò de.
text.english: Wow, amazing! However, I think that interests are important, too. If the work is too boring, I will certainly want to change my job.

text.traditional: 妳對日語有興趣，而且成績很好，應該繼續念研究所，將來當教授啊！
text.simplified: 你对日语有兴趣，而且成绩很好，应该继续念研究所，将来当教授啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ duì Rìyǔ yǒu xìngqù, érqiě chéngjī hěn hǎo, yīnggāi jìxù niàn yánjiùsuǒ, jiānglái dāng jiàoshòu a!
text.english: You are interested in the Japanese language, and you get good grades. You should continue going to a graduate school and become a professor in the future!

text.traditional: 我是有這樣的想法。妳呢？妳的課上得怎麼樣？
text.simplified: 我是有这样的想法。你呢？你的课上得怎么样？
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì yǒu zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ. Nǐ ne? Nǐ de kè shàng de zěnmeyàng?
text.english: I do consider this. What about you? How are you doing in class?

text.traditional: 除了翻譯課比較難，聽力跟會話課的成績都不錯。
text.simplified: 除了翻译课比较难，听力跟会话课的成绩都不错。
text.pinyin: Chúle fānyì kè bǐjiào nán, tīnglì gēn huìhuà kè de chéngjī dōu búcuò.
text.english: Except that the translation class is more difficult, both my listening and conversation grades are not bad.

text.traditional: 台灣好像只有一、兩所大學的外語學院有義大利文系，畢業後應該不難找工作吧？
text.simplified: 台湾好像只有一、两所大学的外语学院有义大利文系，毕业后应该不难找工作吧？
text.pinyin: Táiwān hǎoxiàng zhǐyǒu yì, liǎng suǒ dàxué de wàiyǔ xuéyuàn yǒu Yìdàlì wén xì, bìyè hòu yīnggāi bù nán zhǎo gōngzuò ba?
text.english: It seems that there are only one or two universities in Taiwan where the College of Foreign Language has a Department of Italian Language. It should not be difficult to find a job after graduation, right?

text.traditional: 也許不像念哲學、歷史的那麼難，可是沒有其他的專業能力，想找到好工作也是很困難的。
text.simplified: 也许不像念哲学、历史的那么难，可是没有其他的专业能力，想找到好工作也是很困难的。
text.pinyin: Yěxǔ bú xiàng niàn zhéxué, lìshǐ de nàme nán, kěshì méiyǒu qítā de zhuānyè nénglì, xiǎng zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò yě shì hěn kùnnán de.
text.english: Maybe it’s not as hard as those who study philosophy or history. However, without any other professional skill, it is still very difficult to find a good job.

text.traditional: 我覺得日語老師是很好的職業，所以從下個月起，我就要去當王教授的助理，向他學習怎麼教日文。妳呢？妳希望將來的職業是什麼？
text.simplified: 我觉得日语老师是很好的职业，所以从下个月起，我就要去当王教授的助理，向他学习怎么教日文。你呢？你希望将来的职业是什么？
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Rìyǔ lǎoshī shì hěn hǎo de zhíyè, suǒyǐ cóng xià ge yuè qǐ, wǒ jiùyào qù dāng Wáng jiàoshòu de zhùlǐ, xiàng tā xuéxí zěnme jiāo Rìwén. Nǐ ne? Nǐ xīwàng jiānglái de zhíyè shì shénme?
text.english: I think being a Japanese teacher is a very good job, so from next month I am going to work as Professor Wang’s assistant. I will learn from him how to teach Japanese. And you? What kind of job do you hope to have in the future?

text.traditional: 說真的，我只想去貿易公司上班，當一個小職員就好了。
text.simplified: 说真的，我只想去贸易公司上班，当一个小职员就好了。
text.pinyin: Shuōzhēnde, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng qù màoyì gōngsī shàngbān, dāng yíge xiǎo zhíyuán jiù hǎo le.
text.english: Honestly speaking, I just want to work in a trading company, working as a small office clerk is good enough.

text.traditional: 真的？妳不想自己當老闆嗎？
text.simplified: 真的？你不想自己当老板吗？
text.pinyin: Zhēnde? Nǐ bù xiǎng zìjǐ dāng lǎobǎn ma?
text.english: Really? Don’t you want to be the boss?

text.traditional: 當老闆太累了！像我爸爸是保險公司的經理，管理三十多個員工，不但常常開會、加班，還要做市場研究。
text.simplified: 当老板太累了！像我爸爸是保险公司的经理，管理三十多个员工，不但常常开会、加班，还要做市场研究。
text.pinyin: Dāng lǎobǎn tài lèi le! Xiàng wǒ bàba shì bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ, guǎnlǐ sānshí duō ge yuángōng, búdàn chángcháng kāihuì, jiābān, háiyào zuò shìchǎng yánjiù.
text.english: Being a boss is too tiring! For example, my father is a manager in an insurance company. He manages more than thirty employees. He not only has meetings and works overtime often, but also needs to do market research.

text.traditional: 他要負責這麼多事情，真的太累了，難怪妳不想當老闆。
text.simplified: 他要负责这么多事情，真的太累了，难怪你不想当老板。
text.pinyin: Tā yào fùzé zhème duō shìqíng, zhēnde tài lèi le, nánguài nǐ bù xiǎng dāng lǎobǎn.
text.english: He is responsible for so many things and can be really tired. No wonder you don’t want to be the boss.

text.traditional: 最近他也覺得體力越來越差，做不了那麼多事了，所以想要早一點兒退休。
text.simplified: 最近他也觉得体力越来越差，做不了那么多事了，所以想要早一点儿退休。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn tā yě juéde tǐlì yuèláiyuè chà, zuò bùliǎo nàme duō shì le, suǒyǐ xiǎngyào zǎo yìdiǎnr tuìxiū.
text.english: Recently, he feels that he’s been getting physically weaker and can’t manage to do so many things, so he really wants to retire.

text.traditional: （可欣看看手錶）
text.simplified: （可欣看看手表）
text.pinyin: (Kěxīn kànkan shǒubiǎo)
text.english: (Kexin is looking at the watch.)

text.traditional: 快上課了，我們別想那麼多了。到底要找什麼工作，等大四再說吧。
text.simplified: 快上课了，我们别想那么多了。到底要找什么工作，等大四再说吧。
text.pinyin: Kuài shàngkè le, wǒmen bié xiǎng nàme duō le. Dàodǐ yào zhǎo shénme gōngzuò, děng dà sì zàishuō ba.
text.english: It’s time for class. Don’t think too much. Let’s wait until the senior year to think about looking for a job.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Exclude one person or thing while saying what is true of the rest.
grammarPages.pattern: S + 除了 + excluded item, ... 都 ... / 除了 + excluded item, S + ... 都 ...
grammarPages.explanation: “除了”, which shows exclusion, can be followed by a noun, verb, noun phrase or intransitive state verb. The subject of this pattern can be placed in front of either “除了” or “都”, ie: “我除了咖啡，什麼飲料都喝。” or “除了咖啡，我什麼飲料都喝。”
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “除了”, which shows exclusion, can be followed by a noun, verb, noun phrase or intransitive state verb. The subject of this pattern can be placed in front of either “除了” or “都”, ie: “我除了咖啡，什麼飲料都喝。” or “除了咖啡，我什麼飲料都喝。”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “除了”, which shows exclusion, can be followed by a noun, verb, noun phrase or intransitive state verb. The subject of this pattern can be placed in front of either “除了” or “都”, ie: “我除了咖啡，什麼飲料都喝。” or “除了咖啡，我什麼飲料都喝。”

text.traditional: 我除了影集，什麼電視節目都不愛看。
text.simplified: 我除了影集，什么电视节目都不爱看。
text.pinyin: Wǒ chúle yǐngjí, shénme diànshì jiémù dōu bú ài kàn.
text.english: Except for TV series, I don’t like watching any kind of TV program.

text.traditional: 除了加班，爸爸週末都不去公司，一定在家休息。
text.simplified: 除了加班，爸爸周末都不去公司，一定在家休息。
text.pinyin: Chúle jiābān, bàba zhōumò dōu bú qù gōngsī, yídìng zài jiā xiūxí.
text.english: Except when he works overtime, Dad never goes to the office on weekends; he’s always resting at home.

text.traditional: A：聽說那個研究所的課程很難，教授都用英文上課。B：沒錯，除了電腦課，所有課程都是用英文上的。
text.simplified: A：听说那个研究所的课程很难，教授都用英文上课。B：没错，除了电脑课，所有课程都是用英文上的。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nàge yánjiùsuǒ de kèchéng hěn nán, jiàoshòu dōu yòng Yīngwén shàngkè. B: Méicuò, chúle diànnǎo kè, suǒyǒu kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
text.english: A: I heard the graduate-school courses are hard and the professors teach them all in English. B: That’s right; except for the computer course, all the courses are taught in English.

summary: 除了 means except for. It names what is left out, and 都 comes in the second part.
After 除了 you can use a noun, a verb, or a state verb with no object.
The subject can go before 除了 or before 都.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.titleTraditional: NP₁ + 像／不像 + NP₂ + 那麼／這麼 + Vs
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Not as… as: 不像…那麼
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Compare one person or thing with another using a degree description.
grammarPages.pattern: NP₁ + 像／不像 + NP₂ + 那麼／這麼 + Vs
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern compares NP₁ and NP₂. “那麼” should be followed by an intransitive state verb with a higher degree. This pattern is similar to “NP₁ 有／沒有 NP₂ 那麼 Vs”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern compares NP₁ and NP₂. “那麼” should be followed by an intransitive state verb with a higher degree. This pattern is similar to “NP₁ 有／沒有 NP₂ 那麼 Vs”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern compares NP₁ and NP₂. “那麼” should be followed by an intransitive state verb with a higher degree. This pattern is similar to “NP₁ 有／沒有 NP₂ 那麼 Vs”.

text.traditional: 會話課的考試像翻譯課的（考試）那麼難嗎？
text.simplified: 会话课的考试像翻译课的（考试）那么难吗？
text.pinyin: Huìhuà kè de kǎoshì xiàng fānyì kè de (kǎoshì) nàme nán ma?
text.english: Is the conversation-class exam as difficult as the translation-class exam?

text.traditional: 弟弟的體力不像我這麼好，他在操場跑了十分鐘就累了。
text.simplified: 弟弟的体力不像我这么好，他在操场跑了十分钟就累了。
text.pinyin: Dìdi de tǐlì bú xiàng wǒ zhème hǎo, tā zài cāochǎng pǎo le shífēn zhōng jiù lèi le.
text.english: My younger brother’s stamina is not as good as mine; he gets tired after running on the track for ten minutes.

text.traditional: 黃先生是吉他老師，他的技巧很厲害，我不像他那麼專業。
text.simplified: 黄先生是吉他老师，他的技巧很厉害，我不像他那么专业。
text.pinyin: Huáng xiānshēng shì jítā lǎoshī, tā de jìqiǎo hěn lìhài, wǒ bú xiàng tā nàme zhuānyè.
text.english: Mr. Huang is a guitar teacher, and his technique is impressive. I am not as professional as he is.

summary: 像 or 不像 compares the first thing with the second. 不像 says the first is not as much as the second.
After 那麼 or 這麼 comes a state verb that shows degree.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Mark when an action or situation begins and what follows from that point.
grammarPages.pattern: （S）（+ 從）+ Time／VP + 起，（S）就……
